name: Invoice Desk 6: Weekly Summary
description: Monday 8am email to the owner: documents in, approved spend, items waiting, bills due and what the checks caught. Built in code from the register.

parameters.content:
## Weekly Summary
Every Monday at 8:00 am (Portland, Maine time) the owner gets one email built from the register: documents in, spend approved by category and supplier, what is waiting on them, bills due in the next 7 days, overdue bills, and what the checks caught (overcharges, duplicates, bank changes).

Built in code with no AI, so every number is exact. Text from documents is escaped before it goes into the HTML.
